title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers #6
desc:
Can Jason escape the mental (and physical!) anguish of the Trauma Dumpster?

Jason was once the fearless leader of the Mighty Morphin Power Rangers… but he's worried that he's not cut out for the job anymore. While his friends have moved on to build exciting careers, he's still got the same job he had in high school: teaching martial arts to kids.

It's not that he doesn't love it, but since Tommy's return he's been questioning his ability as a leader and whether he should have made more of himself.

Can he sort out his feelings before he and the Rangers are canned by the devastating Trauma Dumpster and its emotionally manipulative "Truth Bombs"?
